verdict.rationale: Luma documents general text-to-video, image-to-video and video-to-video generation with character references. It also documents expression transfer and lip-sync preservation, but only for existing source footage, which still requires a camera. Nothing in the evidence shows pasting a script and getting a narrated, presenter-led video from a stock or custom avatar. These are adjacent generation features, not the avatar-presenter capability itself.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can paste a script and get a presenter-led video with a stock or custom avatar, no camera or studio
